items.title: Combat Strip & Turn Dock polish
items.do: Start combat with Aveline, Durgan, Sylwen, Kaela, Orc Warrior, and Ogre Chieftain; inspect the top Combat Strip and Turn Dock during a turn, with Reactions pending, and after an initiative swap (Frozen).
items.expect: Combat Strip cards clearly distinguish Acting, waiting-for-Reaction, Frozen, and disposition bands, AP/Reaction/Strike pips stay crisp even at high AP/Reaction counts, and the Turn Dock matches cleanly.

items.title: STYLE-3 Save, Check, and Shake Off Roll Dialog
items.do: On Aveline's sheet, click an Attribute for a Check, Shift-click for a Save, roll a Save from a Save Action card (e.g., Grave Wisp's Dread Whisper on Aveline), and roll Shake Off on a Lingering creature.
items.expect: All Checks, Saves, and Shake Off open the new compact STYLE-3 Roll Dialog (not the old Foundry DialogV2) with the 3-Tier ladder, 5 Boons/Banes cliff, Boons/Banes/Flat controls, and Tier preview where applicable.

items.title: Weapon Range Rings, Z-ordered overlays, and 3D Cover / Area Height tools
items.do: Select Sylwen (Longbow) or Aveline (Longsword) and toggle the new Range & Reach overlay in Token Controls alongside Line of Effect and Show Flanking; also open the Cover Height and 3D Area Height tools from Token Controls.
items.expect: Range & Reach draws Normal/Far/Max weapon bands and Melee Threat Reach below tokens without overlapping LoE plates; overlays layer cleanly in Z-order; Cover Height and 3D Area Height tools open and calculate linked 3D Burst/Emanation/Line geometry cleanly.

items.title: Compact Pick/Confirm dialogs and utility windows
items.do: Trigger a Release/hands prompt on Durgan (e.g., two-handed weapon in one hand, or Release after Seizing Cut Grab), click Collapse/Breather/Heal on Aveline, and open Escalation / Damage Report windows.
items.expect: Pick and confirm dialogs use the new compact card layout with clear subtitles/tags (including "Ends Grabbed · frees your hand" / "0 AP" for Grabbed targets) and warning tones where appropriate; utility windows render cleanly in both light and dark themes.
